what: Nothing in op_template.py or REGISTRY_MODEL.md warns that adding a validate-only axis to SUPPORTED (one the harness never generates) makes eval/feature_matrix.py:168 classify EVERY generated cell as unsupported, zeroing supported_pass. The planner design explicitly told the implementer to put inner_pair in SUPPORTED.
suggest: State in op_template.py/REGISTRY_MODEL.md: SUPPORTED axes must be exactly the harness-generated axis set; extra validate-only gates go in a separate constant checked in validate().
